svg.title: Aliases panel skipped-name line, HOLODEX-453
svg.desc: Before: the line ends in a Review link to the Duplicates queue. After: the line names the entity that holds each skipped name and links to it.
svg.text: BEFORE (F58): REVIEW LINKS TO A QUEUE THAT NO LONGER LISTS THE PAIR
1 name from TMDB was skipped — Jane Doe already belongs to another person. Review
AFTER · ONE NAME: THE HOLDER IS NAMED AND LINKED
1 name from TMDB was skipped — Jane Doe already belongs to Jane A. Doe.
AFTER · SEVERAL NAMES: ONE PAIR PER ITEM, WRAPS, NO CAP
3 names from TMDB were skipped because other people already hold them:
J. Doe → Jane A. Doe · JD → John Dee · Janie → Janie Quinn
(accent = the skin's --accent; surface = --surface-2; ink = --ink. Owner only.)
